name: New Custom Shop Order Columns
author: yakacj

sections.description:
This plugin for WordPress/WooCommerce stores, by this plugin you can add new unlimited custom order columns to shop order list at admin side.
Need to enter column title and meta key for obtain/show value for new column in plugin settings page.

OUR OTHER FREE PLUGINS

Price Changer For WooCommerce:
By this plugin, you can change millions of products price by specific percentage or amount quickly.

Variation Auto Expire For WooCommerce:
By this plugin, you can set auto expiry date/time for variations in WooCommerce.

Support

For any support about this plugin, please view plugin forum or create new topic here forum
sections.installation:
1. Go to WP admin panel, click ‘Plugins’ -> ‘Add new’. In the search input box, type ‘new custom order columns’.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. OR, upload “new-order-columns-in-woocommerce.zip” to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory.
  4. Install and activate the plugin.
  5. Plugin settings found beside activate/deactivate plugin on plugins page, also found on admin menu under woocommerce menu.
sections.faq:
What is use of this plugin?

By using this plugin, you can add unlimited columns and show value to shop order list at admin side in WooCommerce.

Is it easy to integration in my woocommerce store?

Yes, absolutely it is simple, just install and activate plugin, set new column title and meta key for value and save, that’s it.

What are prerequisites needed for this plugin?

WooCommerce plugin should be installed and activated, as this is for WooCommerce only.

Is your plugin compatible with other plugins also?

Yes, tested compatibility with most of plugins which are related to WooCommerce.

Can you customise the plugin or develope different one for me?

Please contact by above Support section link.

Still I have a question or query!

Please create topic in WordPress Plugins forum or contact by above Support section.
